response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent <> 0 AND b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t
